name: Bauernhof Winklerhof
beschreibung: The Winklerhof farm in Ebbs is run as a inn with accommodation. The farm is surrounded by agricultural land. The guest rooms are simply and functionally furnished. The kitchen uses products from its own production. In the dining room, traditional Tiroler dishes are served. The surroundings invite you to walks and hikes. The farm stands for the connection between agriculture and hospitality in Tirol.
